create_group: create a new user group with admin authentication and return group response with member count
get_groups: get all groups filtered by share status for verified user or all groups for admin
get_group_by_id: retrieve a specific group by id with admin authentication and include member count
add_user_to_group: add users to an existing group by id, validating user ids before insertion
delete_group_by_id: delete a group by id with admin authentication and return success status
